name: Rusty Rafts
desc:
The world is in ruin - extreme weather changes cause sudden droughts and floods. The only way to survive in this wasteland is by building and defending your raft that keeps you afloat. A safe haven is rumored to be up north, set sail with your friends and do whatever you can to make it there...

Available on ALL platforms: PC, Mac, XBOX, Playstation, Phone/Mobile and Tablet
